_about: Pack-level cooling topologies. r_th_k_w is the lumped pack-to-ambient thermal resistance; q_dissipation_w is the heat rejected at a 10 K pack-to-ambient difference (= 10 / r_th_k_w). All values are team assumptions with the stated basis — none is measured.

cooling.name: Passive natural-air enclosure
cooling.source: Assumption: free convection h ~ 8 W/m2K (typical 5-10 W/m2K for air) over ~0.28 m2 of enclosure surface -> R = 1/(hA) ~ 0.45 K/W. No added parts.

cooling.name: Forced-air duct + 12 V axial fan
cooling.source: Assumption: forced convection h ~ 35 W/m2K (typical 25-50 W/m2K at low duct velocity) over ~0.28 m2 -> R ~ 0.10 K/W. Fan power, duct mass/volume/cost are class estimates for a 60-80 mm 12 V axial fan.

cooling.name: Aluminium-fin conduction + PCM matrix
cooling.source: Assumption: Al fins spread heat to the enclosure wall (effective area ~3x passive) -> R ~ 0.15 K/W. PCM = paraffin class, latent heat ~200 kJ/kg (typical 150-250), melt point chosen between 40 C ambient and 45 C charge limit. Mass = 0.5 kg fins + 0.8 kg PCM.
